Container.Name: test-invoice
Container.Overview: Allied Fire Test Invoice field app. Static PWA (nginx) - pick client and site, take photos and document scans, then create a Xero draft invoice/quote and email the client the test result, all via n8n. No data is stored in the container.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port the app is served on. The Cloudflare tunnel entry invoice.12wqa.com points at http://TOWER-IP:this-port
